title: Powerade Cosmic Arena
description: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a black silhouette of a horned female character with glowing pink eyes on the left, exploding with vibrant paint splashes. To the right is a large striped planet with a glowing blue 'POWERADE' neon sign, a futuristic vending machine filled with blue bottles, floating drones, spaceships, and multiple planets against a starry purple nebula background.
prompt: A dynamic surreal cosmic advertisement scene with a large black silhouette of a horned female character with glowing pink eyes on the left, unleashing colorful paint-like energy streams. In the center a futuristic vending machine stocked with blue Powerade bottles, a large striped planet displaying a glowing blue neon POWERADE logo, flying drones and spaceships, floating planets and asteroids, vibrant magenta and cyan energy trails across a deep purple starry nebula background.
